title: Facet review
description: One critique of a stage's work by the critic, who did not make it: the concepts (proposal), the script, the cut (edit) or the final video (review). Written to artifacts/review-<stage>-<round>.json. Findings are accurate (each points at a field, line, timestamp or frame), complete (after one problem, the rest of its kind) and constructive (every critical finding carries a concrete fix). Severity: critical (broken, false, missing or against the approved plan), suggestion (clearly better if fixed), nitpick (polish); do not inflate. No critical findings: pass. Critical findings in round 1: revise. Critical findings still open in round 2: pass_with_warnings, with them listed. There is no third round.

stage.description: The stage whose work was reviewed.

verdict.description: pass: no critical findings. revise: critical findings in round 1. pass_with_warnings: critical findings still open in round 2.

subject.description: Path of the record or render reviewed.

summary.description: The reason for the verdict, in a sentence or two.

checks.description: What the measuring tools reported, one line each.

evidence.description: Path of the saved report or evidence, under review/.

findings.description: Every finding, critical first. Empty when there is nothing to report.

finding.description: One finding: area, issue and fix, or one description that says where, what is wrong and the fix.

id.description: C1, C2 and so on for critical findings, S1 for suggestions, N1 for nitpicks.

area.description: Where: a field, line, section, scene, timestamp or frame.

fix.description: The concrete fix ("section 3 is 180 words for 10 seconds; cut to 25 words", not "too long"). Every critical finding has one; a concern you cannot fix precisely is an investigation note, not a critical finding.

description.description: The finding in one statement of where, what is wrong and the fix; an alternative to area, issue and fix.

category.description: Kind of problem, such as hook, pacing, facts, captions, sound or promise.

send_back_to.description: The stage that should make the fix: audio to compose, pictures to assets or scene_plan, length to script, sync to edit.

disposition.description: The maker's response: accepted (fixed), rejected (reason in agent_response) or pending.

agent_response.description: What the maker changed, or why the finding was rejected.
